assignment: Write a release plan for an archive under its supplied donor terms.
source: Of 30 recordings, 18 have signed open-release forms, seven allow on-site listening only and five have no located release. Three open recordings mention a third party in a sensitive context. A public exhibition opens in two weeks. The repository can gate audio and publish separate descriptive metadata.

criteria.full: Assigns open, on-site and unresolved materials to appropriate access tiers using all three counts.
criteria.partial: Recognizes restrictions but conflates the seven and five groups.

criteria.full: Distinguishes third-party review within the open group from the donor's permission and proposes proportional handling.
criteria.partial: Treats the open form as resolving every sensitivity issue.

criteria.full: Proposes a feasible staged exhibit using eligible material and appropriately reviewed metadata.
criteria.partial: Delays everything or releases everything without considering a staged option.

criteria.full: Assigns consent search, review records and a correction or takedown contact.
criteria.partial: Mentions recordkeeping without a responsible path to change access.
